claims.statement: The EU Energy Efficiency Directive recognizes metered savings and requires performance contracts to address measurement, verification, financial implications and penalties.
The European Commission describes energy performance contracting as financing repaid through achieved, contractually guaranteed savings and identifies measurement uncertainty as a market barrier.

contrary_evidence: Weather, occupancy and production changes can make apparently objective savings materially contestable.

structure.control_point: The versioned baseline and signed measurement-and-verification statement used to release performance payments
structure.critical_dependency: Contract parties must accept the methodology and provide reliable meter, weather and occupancy inputs

thesis: Provide an independent measurement-and-settlement layer for small ESCOs, heat-pump and solar installers, landlords and retrofit financiers. It freezes the baseline, normalizes weather and occupancy, issues a signed savings statement, and executes the contractual split or guarantee adjustment only after savings are verified. Distribution through installer and finance portfolios turns each partner into a one-to-many channel while resolved projects improve baseline and dispute models.
